description: Disconnect one Google account: revoke its grant at Google (POST oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke) and delete only that account's tokens from the vault. Other accounts are untouched. If it was the default, the next connected account becomes the default. A revoke failure is reported in revoke_status and the local credentials are still deleted. For an account migrated from the pre-multi-account credential, the legacy vault entries are deleted too. Runs as a background job: a missing or unknown account is refused at once; otherwise dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the outcome arrives via a follow-up message once the revoke and the vault deletion complete (read it any time with service_interface::job_service::get_job).
embedding_description: Unlink one Google account (work, home or a personal Gmail) from this assistant: revoke its access at Google and delete only its stored tokens, leaving other linked accounts working. Reports whether the revoke succeeded and which account is the new default.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the disconnect (job_id, status queued); the finished job's result is {account, revoke_status (revoked, already_invalid, revoke_failed_*), credentials_deleted, new_default}. Completion is delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Say the disconnect is running. Once it completes, confirm which account was disconnected and name the new default if one changed; mention revoke_status only when it is not revoked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: At dispatch: gsuite.unknown_account: no connected account matches; the message lists the connected accounts. gsuite.invalid_params: account missing. In the finished job: gsuite.unknown_account when the account was removed after dispatch. gsuite.invalid_params at dispatch can also mean the session_id/flow_id context is missing. gsuite.api_error at dispatch means the job could not be queued (AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Pick an email or alias from the listed accounts (list_accounts). gsuite.api_error at dispatch: retry once platform startup has completed.
